title: Whole-name wildcard matching for deploy manifests
insight: LeetCode 44 Wildcard Matching: greedy scan that remembers the last star and retries from it on mismatch (or an O(n*m) DP), never exponential backtracking
prompt: The artifact store's manifest selector needs Match in match.go. README.md defines the two wildcards, the whole-name rule and a performance requirement for long names against star-heavy patterns. Please keep the package name and exported signature unchanged, use the standard library only, and verify that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass before handing it back.
